svg.title: A Region Was Not One Identical Community
svg.desc: Locate carefully: The Cordillera is a region; a regional name is not one communitys full identity.. Named example: Ifugao is one particular group and setting, not every Cordillera community.. Evidence scope: A modern museum overview does not establish every colonial institution or boundary.
